observation.command:
cd /workspace && pkill -f 'sva-studio-react:serve' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'run-executor.js' 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
ps -eo pid,args | grep -E '[s]va-studio-react:serve' | wc -l
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'live HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>&1 || echo "app down (expected)"
